sources.title: Noninvertible maps
sources.reviewed: Definitions on PDF pages 0-3; critical-set and absorbing-boundary discussion, equations (2.9)-(2.10), Figure 2.5 on PDF page 8.
sources.visual: Figure 2.5 and its equation/paragraph context inspected from a locally rendered page.
sources.finding: Critical images bounding absorbing regions are established. This is conceptual prior art, not an identified equivalent of Case 988.

sources.title: Three-dimensional discrete-time Lotka-Volterra models with an application to industrial clusters
sources.reviewed: Abstract, equation (1), Section 5 including 5.1, Figure 3 caption and its parameter values, Figures 8-9 with captions, Appendix B critical-surface formula.
sources.visual: PDF page 11 (Figures 8 and 9) and PDF page 2 (equation 1) inspected locally. Figure 3 parameter caption read as text; its image was not visually audited.
sources.finding: Three-dimensional noninvertible folded geometry and critical-surface mechanisms predate this study. Five published parameter values were reproduced separately; local cloud fitting excludes no nonlinear conjugacy.

sources.title: Chaos in the border-collision normal form: A computer-assisted proof using induced maps and invariant expanding cones
sources.reviewed: Abstract, introduction and opening Section 2 framework on PDF pages 0-2; text only.
sources.finding: Methodological precedent combining trapping with expansion for a two-dimensional piecewise-linear family. Its hypotheses were not verified here and its theorem is not applied to this map.
